inputs.text: John Lahart is right that people without children deserve fairness. But fairness should not mean treating family inheritance as something the state is entitled to weaken or redistribute. Families should be free to pass on what they have built, providing security for the next generation and preserving the bonds of responsibility across generations. Respecting people’s different circumstances must not become an excuse for greater state control.
